questions.q: In a nutritional assessment, albumin is often used as a lab marker. However, its reliability is affected because it is a:
questions.explain: Albumin decreases during inflammation/stress (negative acute-phase reactant), so low levels may reflect illness rather than just malnutrition. Prealbumin is better for shorter-term changes.
